name: Slider / AI Creativity
description: AI Creativity product scenario for the Slider component.

controls.name: value
controls.description: Controlled finite number or nonempty array. Values are snapped and sorted.

controls.name: defaultValue
controls.description: Initial uncontrolled value(s), restored on reset. Defaults to min.

controls.name: min
controls.description: Finite lower bound and step origin. Defaults to 0.

controls.name: max
controls.description: Finite upper bound, at least min. Defaults to 100.

controls.name: step
controls.description: Positive finite increment. End selects the last step at or below max. Defaults to 1.

controls.name: disabled
controls.description: Disable editing and submission, including crop. Defaults to false.

controls.name: orientation
controls.description: Horizontal follows text direction; vertical increases upward. Defaults to horizontal.

controls.name: label
controls.description: Visible noninteractive name, including rich text.

controls.name: aria-label
controls.description: Name when there is no visible label, or override for it.

controls.name: aria-labelledby
controls.description: External naming elements; takes precedence over label and aria-label.

controls.name: labels
controls.description: Specific or localized names for individual controls.

controls.name: showValue
controls.description: Display the value inside each primary handle. Defaults to false.

controls.name: crop
controls.description: Enable two editable crop boundaries independently of value presentation. Defaults to false.

controls.name: cropRange
controls.description: Controlled crop boundaries, sorted and snapped to the same step grid.

controls.name: defaultCropRange
controls.description: Initial uncontrolled crop, restored on reset. Defaults to the full range.

controls.name: clampToCrop
controls.description: Constrain primary values to the accepted crop. Defaults to true.

controls.name: name
controls.description: Native form key, repeated for ordered primary values.

controls.name: cropName
controls.description: Native form key, repeated for crop start/end when crop is enabled.

controls.name: form
controls.description: External form id for all controls.

controls.name: autoFocus
controls.description: Focus the first primary thumb on mount. Defaults to false.

controls.name: membrane
controls.description: Shared spacing around handles and label. Defaults to true.
